name: Shinobi Yakimochi yo
source:
Set in a stage inspired by the Sengoku period, the protagonist is a female ninja serving a certain daimyo. She confronts the rumored mysterious phenomenon within the mansion,
which leads to various erotic developments in this adventure otome game.
Being a short story of about 15 minutes per playthrough, it focuses on a single situation with no full-cast interactions.
